description:
Charming three-bedroom semi-detached family home in the sought-after village of Tallentire.

This delightful property boasts three double bedrooms, each with walk-in wardrobes, offering ample storage space. The split-level accommodation includes a modern fitted kitchen dining room, perfect for family meals, and a light and airy living room featuring a wood burning stove for cosy evenings in. With a first-floor bathroom and ground floor cloakroom w.c., convenience is key.

The property also benefits from a private lawned rear garden, ideal for outdoor relaxation, along with off-street parking and an integral garage.

Situated in a private courtyard development, Blencathra Cottage offers a peaceful retreat in the picturesque village of Tallentire. Just a short drive from Cockermouth and the stunning landscapes of the Lake District National Park, this home combines countryside charm with modern comfort.

Book a viewing today to experience the tranquility

Directions Upon entering the village of Tallentire follow the road into the one-way system, at the bottom of the hill the road bends to the right and a short distance away the first turning on the right leads onto the courtyard development and Blencathra Cottage can be found on the right.

Services Electric heating with mains electric, water and drains being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
